title: No Turning Back
subtitle: She walked into the fire and burned to ash.

items.text: Mei Tree, Ancient Zhu County
Lightning tears through the thick clouds, shaking the earth with each strike.
Master Rén stands before the Mei tree, unmoved by the clashing of earth and sky. Her students sit around her in a ring with muted, fearful reverence. Mayfly is among them, sitting at the front.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: This Mei tree has ever been the root of our school, and now, it is the key to our greatest triumph.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: We must protect it at all costs.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Now, on my command: Form the array.

items.speaker: School of Mei Believers
items.text: By nature's might, evil be purged!

As the believers channel their energy into the array, the ground shakes violently and a massive sinkhole opens around them, swallowing sand and stones. Soon after, water wells up from the pit, forming into a lake.
Golden rays shoot out from the lake, projecting daylight onto the clouds like a rising sun.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Ahahahaha. "The balance will be broken, and the sun and moon shall share the sky," so that's what the warning was about.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: The beast has battled with the White Horse School for a millennium. But today, it will die by my hand.

items.speaker: Yam
items.text: But where is the beast?

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Its body has long merged with the land. This very lake is its eye, the only part we may yet reach.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: The time has come. Let it begin.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Through the might of all eight powers, we harness the flow of Qi!
Master Rén begins an incantation and chants. A typhoon erupts around her, whipping their new lake into a frothing whirlpool.
Beneath the golden shimmer, a Bagua array appears at the lake's edge, locking it down like a cage of light.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: This Quelling Array has been the work of decades. Once it begins, there will be no escape for Lǎnzhū. Its death is certain.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: With it, I will reach my goal, even without the sword.
Suddenly, Yam vanishes. In the smoke, a red light breaks through.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Begone!
Master Rén leaps to dodge the attack, but Paper Heron's paper slips prove faster, and a few pieces tear at her robe's hem.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Stop her.

items.speaker: Badger
items.text: Yes, Master.
Several students form a defensive line. Long swords pointing out at the two.

items.speaker: Hedgehog
items.text: You'll have to get past us first, Heron.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Stand back. I'm not here to fight you.
Yet the Yao don't move. They stare at Paper Heron expectantly.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Take this!
Silver streaks flash in, breaking the standoff. The Yao are helpless to deflect the sudden barrage of needles.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Aghh!

items.speaker: Hedgehog
items.text: Master!
Though it was only a brief moment of distraction, Master Rén staggers against the immense pressure crushing down on her.

items.speaker: Badger
items.text: Hold the line!
Before the Yao can react, Chéng Héguāng drives his blade into the Quelling Array, seeking an opening to strike its core.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Agh! Protect the array!

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Stop this now, Rén! If the array shatters ...

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: It will bring about your annihilation.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Enough talk.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: There's nothing you can do to stop me. Get out of my way!

With an earth-shattering scream, Master Rén's body shrivels up like a burst grape. Blood-stained fragments scattering apart like Mei petals. The wind reveals her human form and buries the fallen believers.
Paper Heron struggles to reach Mayfly.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Mayfly, you mustn't feed any more of your Qi to the array. You're draining yourself away.
She reaches out desperately, trying to pull her little friend to safety.
Yet Mayfly doesn't move.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: I can't turn back now, Heron.
Struggling, she pulls the amulet from her pocket and lays it beside her along with that wrinkled note.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Thank you for helping me get this far.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: I-I wanted this. I wanted to try. I have no regrets.
She slumps over, unable to even pull herself up, yet she raises her head and looks toward Paper Heron.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Good, sister. Let go now. Your wish has been fulfilled.
Master Rén struggles to her feet, clinging to the array, unwilling to abandon her chance at ascension.
The wind whips and howls around the lake. Then, as her Qi at last runs out, Mayfly's body collapses.
The amulet and note are swept up in the typhoon and torn to shreds.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Mayfly!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Heron, watch out!
She loses focus for only a moment, but it's enough time for several blades to strike at her. Chéng Héguāng whirls around and blocks them with the sheath of his blade.
Her strength fails her. Paper Heron suddenly feels as if the sword in her hand were as heavy as a mule.
Black clouds press down against the sky. Thunder rolls. The earth tears open and slams shut. Sheets of coarse sand billow through the air. Huanzhou is lost.
Cries of anguish fill the streets. Even the constables can barely protect themselves. There is no place left to run.
Behind Master Rén, more Yao fall. Fox, Hare, Butterfly ...
Paper Heron looks to Mayfly's spot. Nothing remains there but a tuft of reeds, trampled by other frantic Yao.
What is lost can never be recovered.
Countless torn fragments swirl around, caught in the raging typhoon.
They drift past her like everything in the world always has, leaving nothing marked on her stone heart.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Why?

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Why come all this way in seeking to extend your life, only to give it up so easily?

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Why must you come to this world, only to leave it so soon?
A question that might as well be asked to all living things.
She stands alone in the air, holding the Longevity Sword. The world around her has become a void of darkness.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: I spent so long trapped inside that tree that I forgot what it felt like to be a part of the world.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Joy, sorrow, and pain became like distant memories.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: But what is this bitterness that racks my heart now?
She lowers her head and examines the sword in her hands.
Some of the Qi stored inside the Longevity Sword flows out into the array, pulled through the air like silk drawn from a cocoon.

items.speaker: Pearl Finch
items.text: Come, Heron, come. You must be starved after that detention. I've saved you some taro. Best not let the master see it.

items.speaker: Master
items.text: Cheeky little rascal. I hope no one finds out you were my student on your travels.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: You-You saved my life. I swear I will repay you. I'll do whatever it takes.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: So? How is it? Amazing, right? I told you it's delicious.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: I-I wanted this. I wanted to try. I have no regrets.

items.speaker: White Horse School Students
items.text: Over here, Heron. Under the Mei tree.

items.speaker: Master
items.text: Remember, Paper Heron. In the end, we need only answer to our conscience.
The scenes she replayed countless times over a hundred years now vanish from her in a single moment.
Paper Heron tilts her head back, and a single tear shatters against the sheath.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: I understand now.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: It wasn't my isolation that numbed my senses. It was regret.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: For a hundred years, it was the only thing I knew.
She draws the Longevity Sword from its sheath, her hand slow and deliberate, revealing the white jade blade.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: The beast's rage has grown beyond control. Whether Rén ascends or not, Huanzhou will fall to ruin. Unless ...
All things return to their beginning.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Master, now I understand why I survived.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: I have an unfinished purpose. And now, I will realize it.
She grips the Longevity Sword with both hands. A crack forms across the blade.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Only one who witnessed the first seal as it was forged long ago can see this done.
Far beneath her, Master Rén takes notice of the change in her former teacher.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Heron, what do you think you're doing?

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: If you shatter the sword, those Yao will have died for nothing, and the White Horse School will be gone forever.
Yet the howling wind drowns out her cry.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: If the sword breaks, the Method of Longevity will die with it.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: And the legacy of the White Horse School will be forever lost.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Heron, you'll never forgive yourself for this.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Shatter the sword, and everything here will be sealed for another hundred years or more, your new friend included.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Do it!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: If you believe it is necessary, do not hold back.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: You're mad. How could you be willing to seal yourself into that tree again?

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: For years, I have dwelled on the day my master shattered the first sword, trying to understand his thoughts, his fears, his hopes.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: My mind is set, even if I must give up my senses and become like stone again.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Like him, once again, I will shatter the sword.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: And like him, once again, I will feel no regret.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: See you in a hundred years.
